description: This script initializes and manages wireless hardware settings for a WiFi device, including configuration of wireless interfaces, environment variables, and process control via command-line arguments.

methods.name: prevent_netifd_to_configure_wireless
methods.description: Stops wireless daemon and deletes existing wireless configurations, then logs a warning message.

methods.name: get_base_wan_address
methods.description: Sets environment variables for WAN and WLAN addresses based on system configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: init_wld
methods.description: Initializes wireless device environment, runs pre-initialization scripts, and prepares the system for wireless management.

calls: logger -t $name -p daemon.warn "Wireless is managed by prplMesh Wireless Hardware Manager"
